# Silver Rubanza

> Machine Learning Engineer and Software Developer based in Kampala, Uganda. Over 7 years of hands-on ML experience building end-to-end production-ready machine learning systems, with 6+ years of software and web development. Deep expertise across the full ML lifecycle — from data analysis and feature engineering to model building, deployment, testing, and monitoring.

Silver Rubanza specialises in the intersection of machine learning and software engineering. He can implement diverse architectures from scratch, ranging from gradient boosting and neural networks to large-scale generative AI systems including image generation models and large language models. Core stack: Python, PyTorch, fastai, sklearn, React, and modern web technologies.

## Skills

- Machine Learning: Exploratory Data Analysis, Feature Engineering, Model Building and Evaluation
- ML Deployment: Model serving, testing, monitoring, and integration into software solutions
- Architectures: Gradient boosting, neural networks, diffusion models, LLMs, fine-tuning
- Software Development: Python, PyTorch, fastai, sklearn
- Web Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React

## Projects

- [ML Model Deployment with Modal](https://sticker-sales.flexiblefunctions.com/): Serving and deploying a sticker sales forecasting model using Modal and FastAI
- [ML Model Deployment with BentoML](https://nbsanity.com/static/64b506b80020adafd31defb4d6afb508/load.html): Serving and deploying a binary classification model using BentoML and FastAI
- [AI Medical Assistant](https://fsdp-qdora-ucg.flexiblefunctions.com/): AI system for assisted differential diagnosis based on the Uganda Clinical Guidelines
- [Stable Diffusion from the Foundations](https://stable-diffusion-1.flexiblefunctions.com): Walkthrough of Stable Diffusion from theoretical foundations to full implementation
- [Academic Success Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/code/rubanzasilva/fastai-gradient-boosting): Predicting student dropout and academic success using FastAI and gradient boosting
- [Used Car Price Prediction](https://www.kaggle.com/code/rubanzasilva/used-cars-eda-fastai-gradient-boosting): Regression model to predict used car prices with EDA, FastAI, and gradient boosting
- [Mushroom Poisonous Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/code/rubanzasilva/fast-ai-gradient-boosting): Binary classification of poisonous mushrooms using FastAI and gradient boosting
- [Insurance Cross-Selling Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/code/rubanzasilva/fastai-neural-network-gradient-boosting): Predicting customer response to automobile insurance offers
- [Antelope Classifier](https://rubanzasilva.github.io/antelope-classifier-documentation/): Computer vision model for antelope species classification, deployed with a full UI
- [Flexible Functions](https://www.flexiblefunctions.com/): AI lab building practical, cost-effective AI use cases
- [Zigoti Coffee Website](https://www.zicofe.com/): E-commerce site for a Ugandan coffee house covering the full coffee value chain
- [Suwik Investments Website](https://www.suwik.xyz/): E-commerce site for a Ugandan agricultural products exporter
